item.title: A Lock Is Only as Good as Its Release
item.description: Every “build a lock on Redis” tutorial spends its time on acquisition: SET key value NX PX 30000, one winner, done. The release gets one line, DEL key, and that line is where most of the lock bugs I’ve had in ePHPm lived. Over about three months the same mistake showed up in the native session handler, in two of the Composer wrapper packages, and finally in the cluster, each time in a slightly different costume.
